welcome.title: Open a MuMain folder
welcome.hint: Choose one folder; what can be translated in it is found automatically:
welcome.chooseHint: English (en) is the source every translation follows. A group without a translation for the chosen language is shown as untranslated.
welcome.newHint: Translations are added on the first save (new files such as Game.th.resx, and a "th" name in the item files).
welcome.newInvalid: A language code such as th, ko or pt-BR.
welcome.newExists: This folder already has translations for it: they are opened.
welcome.webHint: Web version: choose the folder and allow the browser to edit it. Nothing is uploaded: the files are read and written right on your computer.
welcome.kindCheckout: a MuMain checkout (the game's strings and item names):
welcome.kindGame: a game folder (item names only; a released game has no string tables):
welcome.kindFolder: or src/Localization, Data or Data/Items itself.
welcome.noResx: No string tables here (they only exist in a MuMain checkout).
welcome.fallbackHint: This browser cannot edit files in place (Chrome or Edge can). Choose the folder anyway: only the files to translate are read into a copy kept in this browser (nothing is sent anywhere), and saving downloads the changed files - one file as it is, several as a zip laid out like the folder - to put back over it.
welcome.localeNameHint: In its own language. Shown in the tool and in the lines suggested for the game’s language list; kept for this folder.

topbar.reloadTitle: Read the files again from disk (after a git pull, or after editing them elsewhere)
topbar.buildFailsTitle: ResxGen would stop the MuMain build because of the en files. Pick the rows with a red mark in the list.
topbar.saveTitle: Write the changed files (Ctrl+S). The previous versions go to .mumain-translator/backups.
topbar.translatorTitle: Your name, written in the change log
topbar.resxTitle: The game's string tables: {dir} (compiled into the client by MuMain's build: rebuild to see a change).
topbar.itemsTitle: Item names: {dir} (read by the game at start: restart it to see a change).
topbar.browserCopyTitle: This browser cannot write to your folders, so you are editing a copy kept in the browser. Saving downloads the changed files: put them back into the folder (a zip unpacks over it).
topbar.localeTitle: Translate another language of this folder, or rename this one

toolbar.search: Search key, English, translation…  (#470 = legacy id, 7:1 = item)

state.missing: Not translated: the game shows the English text
state.extra: Not in the English file: ResxGen skips it

detail.empty: Select a row to see its details.
detail.tokens: Shown in the text: ↵ line break written as \n, # line break of the Item Shop texts, ⏎ real line break, highlighted = placeholder.
detail.keepTitle: Stays English on purpose (Alt+K): no more “identical to English” note. Written as “keep” in the comment of the file.
detail.removeTitle: Take the key out of the file: the game shows the English text
detail.editHint: Enter saves, Esc cancels. Write a line break as \n, like the English text.
detail.keys: Keys: Enter or F2 edit · Tab / Shift+Tab next / previous · Alt+1/2/3 status · Alt+K keep English · Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y undo / redo · Ctrl+S save · Ctrl+F search
detail.notePlaceholder: Note for the team (saved with the translation state)
detail.itemHelp: An item name: at most 49 characters (the game cuts the rest); empty = the game shows the English name. Keys: Enter or F2 edit · Tab / Shift+Tab next / previous · Alt+1/2/3 status · Ctrl+S save · search 7:1 for item 1 of group 7.
detail.editHintItem: Enter saves, Esc cancels. Empty = not translated (the game shows the English name).

token.hash: Line break of the Item Shop texts (#)
token.nl: Real line break inside the value
token.ph: Placeholder: keep it, in the same order
token.bad: Backslash that is not part of \n

issue.blank-key: The key is only whitespace: ResxGen stops the build.
issue.identifier-too-long: The key gives a C++ name of {length} characters ({identifier}); the limit is {max}: the build stops.
issue.identifier-collision: Gives the same C++ name ({identifier}) as the key “{other}”: the build stops.
issue.legacy-id-collision: legacy_id {legacyId} is also used by “{other}”: the build stops.
issue.no-identifier: No usable C++ name (no ASCII letter or digit): ResxGen skips this key, the text can never be shown.
issue.missing-default: This group has no English file: the build stops.
issue.duplicate-key: The key appears twice in this file (first at line {firstLine}); only the last one is used.
issue.duplicate-key-lost: The key appears twice in this file (first at line {firstLine}); only the last one is used, so legacy_id {lostLegacyIds} is lost.
issue.missing-name: A data element without a name (ignored).
issue.extra-key: This key is not in the English file: ResxGen ignores it.
issue.printf-mismatch: Placeholders differ from English: expected {expected}, found {actual}. The game can show garbage or crash.
issue.printf-added: Has a placeholder ({actual}) where English has none.
issue.percent-style: Write the percent sign as {expected}, like the English text.
issue.format-arg-mismatch: Placeholders differ from English: expected {expected}, found {actual}.
issue.newline-mismatch: English has {expected} line break(s) \n, the translation {actual}.
issue.hash-mismatch: English has {expected} # (Item Shop line breaks), the translation {actual}.
issue.stray-backslash-newline: A backslash followed by a real line break: write \n instead.
issue.stray-backslash-end: A backslash at the end of the text.
issue.stray-backslash-other: A backslash that is not part of \n (followed by “{next}”).
issue.raw-newline: {count} real line break(s) where English has none: write \n instead.
issue.edge-whitespace: Spaces at the start or end differ from English.
issue.empty-value: Empty translation: the game shows nothing. Remove it to fall back to English.
issue.not-nfc: Accents are not in the composed form (NFC): some game fonts show them badly.
issue.same-as-en: Identical to English: not translated yet, or meant to stay English.
issue.keep-outdated: Marked “keep English”, but the English text has changed since: keep it again or translate it.
issue.name-too-long: The name is {chars} characters; the game shows {max} and cuts the rest.
issue.name-separator: The name contains "{'||'}" (MuMain's language separator): the game refuses to start.
issue.name-invalid-char: The name contains a control character or a broken Unicode character.

glossary.title: Glossary

glossary.editHint: Edit (or double-click the row). Enter applies, Esc cancels.

exportDialog.title: Export translations
exportDialog.body: Creates a TSV file (opens in Excel / Google Sheets) with the English text, the translation, status, translator, note and the merge base, so another copy can import it without losing anyone's work. Rows not translated yet are included with an empty translation: fill them in a sheet and import the file back.
exportDialog.mineHint: Changed by “{name}” since the files you started from.

importDialog.title: Import translations
importDialog.noBase: This file has no BaseText column (a sheet made by hand), so conflicts cannot be detected: every different text is listed as a change. Review before applying.

importDialog.problems: {n} line was skipped (no Group / Key, or a duplicate). | {n} lines were skipped (no Group / Key, or a duplicate).

registration.body: ResxGen builds every {locale} file it finds, but the game's language list is written by hand. Add these lines to the MuMain code, then rebuild. This tool does not edit them.
registration.addAfter: Add this line after the one for “{after}”:
registration.addFirst: Add this line at the top of the list:
registration.copyFailed: Could not copy: select the line and copy it by hand.
registration.unknownName: The name of “{locale}” in its own language is not known here: replace “{locale}” in the lines with it.
